attributes.name: v
attributes.description: Polyhedron vertices in local coordinate system.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size of the grain in meters - x,y,z - before random rotation

attributes.name: wire
attributes.description: Whether this Shape is rendered using color surfaces, or only wireframe (can still be overridden by global config of the renderer).

attributes.name: highlight
attributes.description: Whether this Shape will be highlighted when rendered.

attributes.name: dispIndex
attributes.description: Return class index of this instance.

methods.name: GetSurfaces
methods.description: get indices of surfaces' vertices (for postprocessing)

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Return polyhedra volume (duplicate of GetVolume<Polyhedra.GetVolume>, though with a better syntax)

methods.name: setVertices
methods.description: set vertices and update receiver. Takes a list/tuple of vertices as argument.

methods.name: setVertices4
methods.description: set 4 vertices and update receiver. Each vertex is single argument.
